container.title: AI Eco Meter
cmd.logManual: Log manual AI usage (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini...)
cfg.language: Language of the dashboard, the game and the notifications. **Automatic** follows the VS Code display language (Portuguese if it is Portuguese, English otherwise).
cfg.dailyEnergyBudgetWh: Your **daily energy goal** (Wh) for AI use. The mascot’s mood and the gauges are relative to it. For reference: 1 h of video streaming ≈ 77 Wh.
cfg.sources.claudeCode: Read Claude Code usage from local logs (~/.claude/projects).
cfg.sources.codex: Read OpenAI Codex CLI usage from local logs (~/.codex/sessions).
cfg.sources.geminiCli: Read Gemini CLI usage from local logs (~/.gemini/tmp/*/chats). Real tokens.
cfg.sources.antigravity: Estimate **Antigravity** usage (~/.gemini/antigravity). Conversations are stored encrypted, so this is a **rough estimate** based on each conversation’s size, not real tokens.
cfg.paths.claudeCode: Alternative Claude Code projects folder. Empty = ~/.claude/projects (or $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects).
cfg.paths.gemini: Alternative Gemini CLI sessions folder. Empty = ~/.gemini/tmp.
cfg.coefficients.whPer1kOutputTokens: Estimated energy (Wh) per **1,000 generated tokens** (output), for a mid-size model. Generating tokens is the most expensive part of inference.
cfg.coefficients.whPer1kInputTokens: Estimated energy (Wh) per **1,000 input tokens** processed without cache.
cfg.coefficients.whPer1kCacheWriteTokens: Estimated energy (Wh) per **1,000 tokens written to the cache**.
cfg.coefficients.whPer1kCacheReadTokens: Estimated energy (Wh) per **1,000 tokens read from the cache** (much cheaper than reprocessing).
cfg.waterLitersPerKWh: Liters of water per kWh (data center cooling + part of the water used to generate electricity).
cfg.gridCo2GramsPerKWh: Carbon intensity of the power grid (g CO₂e/kWh). Global average ≈ 450; US ≈ 380.
cfg.modelMultipliers: Energy multiplier per model family (the first matching part of the name wins). Larger models use more energy per token.
cfg.refreshIntervalSeconds: How often (in seconds) the logs are re-read.
cfg.showStatusBar: Show today’s usage in the status bar.
cfg.pets.enabled: Show pixel-art pets strolling at the bottom of the dashboard.
cfg.pets.list: Which pets appear (up to 6, repeats allowed). Options: `gato` (cat), `cachorro` (dog), `pato` (duck), `capivara` (capybara), `tartaruga` (turtle), `caranguejo` (crab).
cfg.pets.inEditor: Experimental: show small pets inside the editor, right after the code on the last visible line. They follow the file’s scrolling. Uses an unofficial editor decoration trick.
cfg.game.enabled: Enable the **Planet Yard** in the Pets tab: the pets grow plants and harvest seeds on their own. The pace follows your AI usage for the day.
